cond_0001.intro: We are hiring a Marketing Analyst to join our collaborative and progressive analytics team. This position is for you if you're a curious, analytical person, fascinated by marketing and consumer behavior, with a compulsion to understand why. You see a problem and your mind starts racing with possibilities to solve it. You've got strong opinions about marketing, digital strategies, content, and media, and you're not afraid to share them. You're comfortable in a crowd: presenting to high profile clients, advocating with other internal stakeholders for your ideas, and displaying the tenacity to make incremental improvements everywhere you look.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
● Dive deep into the performance analysis of our agency's flagship account, using a variety of tools ranging from site analytics to data from paid and owned channels.
● Craft biweekly, monthly, and quarterly reports that unveil intriguing trends and insights, paving the way for strategic recommendations that make an impact.
● Collaborate closely with both internal and client teams, inspiring and guiding them to develop and execute strategies that elevate campaigns, all backed by thorough research and analysis of performance metrics.
● Unleash your creativity by exploring social listening tools and tapping into third-party data sources, fueling the ideation and creation of compelling content.
● Learn our agency's cutting-edge BI stack, including Funnel, Snowflake, and Sigma. Be at the forefront of innovation by building dynamic dashboards to suit our evolving needs.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
● 1-2 Years of hands-on experience in analytics, with at least 1 year focused on marketing.
● Proficiency in using Web Analytics platforms such as GA4, Adobe Experience Cloud, or similar tools.
● Familiarity with various ad platforms (e.g., Meta, X, Google Ads) to extract and analyze performance data effectively.
● Proficiency in tag management solutions like Google Tag Manager, ensuring seamless data tracking and management.
● Keen sense for data interpretation, integrity, and analysis.
● Strong written and verbal communication skills, coupled with the ability to effectively engage with clients.
● Adaptable and flexible, with a collaborative nature capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Preferred Requirements
● Experience in conducting A/B testing and experimenting with different strategies.
● Experience in using query languages like SQL and RegEx to extract insights from complex datasets.
● Hands-on experience with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) tools for organizing data in a relational database.
● Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, with the ability to translate raw data into informative dashboards.
● Eagerness and curiosity to learn and grow.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

You see a problem and your mind starts racing with possibilities to solve it. You've got strong opinions about marketing, digital strategies, content, and media, and you're not afraid to share them. You're comfortable in a crowd: presenting to high profile clients, advocating with other internal stakeholders for your ideas, and displaying the tenacity to make incremental improvements everywhere you look.
cond_0389.responsibilities:
● Dive deep into the performance analysis of our agency's flagship account, using a variety of tools ranging from site analytics to data from paid and owned channels.
● Craft biweekly, monthly, and quarterly reports that unveil intriguing trends and insights, paving the way for strategic recommendations that make an impact.
● Collaborate closely with both internal and client teams, inspiring and guiding them to develop and execute strategies that elevate campaigns, all backed by thorough research and analysis of performance metrics.
● Unleash your creativity by exploring social listening tools and tapping into third-party data sources, fueling the ideation and creation of compelling content.
● Learn our agency's cutting-edge BI stack, including Funnel, Snowflake, and Sigma. Be at the forefront of innovation by building dynamic dashboards to suit our evolving needs.
cond_0389.requirements:
● Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in analytics, with at least 1 year focused on marketing.
● Deep knowledge of web analytics platforms such as GA4, Adobe Experience Cloud, or similar tools.
● Proficiency in various ad platforms (e.g., Meta, X, Google Ads) to extract and analyze performance data effectively.
● Strong command of tag management solutions like Google Tag Manager, ensuring seamless data tracking and management.
● Proven track record of data interpretation, integrity, and analysis.
● Exceptional ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a collaborative and adaptable working style.
● Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with clients.
● Solid understanding of A/B testing methodologies and a proven record of experimenting with different strategies.
● Expertise in query languages such as SQL and RegEx, enabling extraction of valuable insights from complex datasets.
● Substantial hands-on expertise with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) tools for organizing data in a relational database.
● Advanced knowledge of data visualization tools such as Tableau, with a proven ability to translate raw data into clear, informative dashboards.

At [Company name masked], we create rich content experiences that drive brand transformation. We are a proudly independent, full-service agency with a 40-year history of innovation in the content discipline. Our team has been honored numerous times as Content Agency of the Year, we've won an Effie for Sustained Success and Digiday's Content Agency Partner of the Year -- to name just a few accolades. We pride ourselves on collaboration without restraint and don't just hire people who fit, we hire disruptors who add to our culture. We embrace different backgrounds and experiences, differing opinions, discussion, productive debate and earned trust. Let's chat.
We are hiring a Marketing Analyst to join our collaborative and progressive analytics team. This position is for you if you're a curious, analytical person, fascinated by marketing and consumer behavior, with a compulsion to understand why. You see a problem and your mind starts racing with possibilities to solve it. You've got strong opinions about marketing, digital strategies, content, and media, and you're not afraid to share them. You're comfortable in a crowd: presenting to high profile clients, advocating with other internal stakeholders for your ideas, and displaying the tenacity to make incremental improvements everywhere you look. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic behind marketing data and consumer behavior.
cond_0400.responsibilities:
● Dive deep into the performance analysis of our agency's flagship account, using a variety of tools ranging from site analytics to data from paid and owned channels.
● Craft biweekly, monthly, and quarterly reports that unveil intriguing trends and insights, paving the way for strategic recommendations that make an impact.
● Collaborate closely with both internal and client teams, inspiring and guiding them to develop and execute strategies that elevate campaigns, all backed by thorough research and analysis of performance metrics.
● Unleash your creativity by exploring social listening tools and tapping into third-party data sources, fueling the ideation and creation of compelling content.
● Learn our agency's cutting-edge BI stack, including Funnel, Snowflake, and Sigma. Be at the forefront of innovation by building dynamic dashboards to suit our evolving needs.
cond_0400.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
● 1-2 Years of hands-on experience in analytics, with at least 1 year focused on marketing.
● Proficiency in using Web Analytics platforms such as GA4, Adobe Experience Cloud, or similar tools.
● Familiarity with various ad platforms (e.g., Meta, X, Google Ads) to extract and analyze performance data effectively.
● Proficiency in tag management solutions like Google Tag Manager, ensuring seamless data tracking and management.
● Keen sense for data interpretation, integrity, and analysis.
● Adaptable and flexible, with a collaborative nature capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
● Strong written and verbal communication skills, coupled with the ability to effectively engage with clients.
Preferred Requirements
● Experience in conducting A/B testing and experimenting with different strategies.
● Experience in using query languages like SQL and RegEx to extract insights from complex datasets.
● Hands-on experience with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) tools for organizing data in a relational database.
● Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, with the ability to translate raw data into informative dashboards.
● Eagerness, ambition, and curiosity to learn and grow.
cond_0400.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0400.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.
